description_en: Queries the port mapping table of a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingPortMappings接口查询生成的端口映射表（自定义路由类型监听）
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-port-mappings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingPortMappings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance whose port mapping table you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询端口映射表的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener whose port mapping table you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询端口映射表的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group whose port mapping table you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询端口映射表的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

PortMappings.description_en: The information about the port mappings

items.description_en: The information about the port mapping

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance to which the port mapping belongs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 端口映射表所属全球加速实例ID

DestinationSocketAddress.description_en: The IP address and port of the backend service
DestinationSocketAddress.description_zh: 后端实例服务IP地址与端口信息

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the backend service

Port.description_en: The port of the backend service

DestinationTrafficState.description_en:
The traffic policy for the backend instance.

allow: allows the backend instance to receive traffic.

deny: denies the backend instance from receiving traffic
DestinationTrafficState.description_zh:
后端实例流量通行策略。

allow：允许后端实例接收流量。

deny：不允许后端实例接收流量

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region to which the endpoint group belongs

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the custom routing listener to which the port mapping belongs
ListenerId.description_zh: 端口映射表所属自定义路由类型监听ID

Protocols.description_en:
The protocol of the backend service.

TCP: the TCP protocol.

UDP: the UDP protocol
Protocols.description_zh:
后端服务协议类型。

TCP：TCP协议。

UDP：UDP协议

items.description_en:
The protocol of the backend service.

TCP: the TCP protocol.

UDP: the UDP protocol
items.description_zh:
后端服务协议类型。

TCP：TCP协议。

UDP：UDP协议

Vswitch.description_en: The name of the vSwitch of the endpoint
Vswitch.description_zh: 终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例名称

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
